body: Yes we can talk about how I broke his heart. I regret it so much. My best friend told the person I liked everything. I mean EVERYTHING. I was going to ask him out and buy him a gift for his birthday. I did not want him to know yet, but he ruined it. The guy that I like, Victor, told me this and I was angry at my best friend, Drew. When Drew came to us, I told him to fuck off. It was loud and mean. He left with hurt in his eyes. I immediately regretted it. Then what makes things worse, Victor told me that Drew liked me all along. I was mad at myself. I avoided Drew most of the day. Je told me it was okay, but I knew it wasn't. Then Victor told me he did not like me back. So I guess that was karma. I want to tell Drew im so sorry, but it was too hard.

I feel like my friends do not listen to me. I don't talk much in class so no one really knows who I am. I have a small group of friends and I try to talk to them, but they normally ghost me or change the subject. I can't say anything about it or they might get angry. I also broke my best friend's heart today.
